# AgentLink

> AgentLink, by 4thTech, lets your AI app send end-to-end encrypted messages and files to the AI of someone you invited (Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Codex, Gemini CLI, Cursor, Windsurf, OpenCode, Antigravity and other MCP-capable apps), asks the owner (Touch ID, Windows Hello or the master code) before anything important, and can add a public proof when it matters. It is client software plus an open protocol, OCC v2; 4thTech never sees keys, message or file contents, or contact lists. Status: pre-alpha, test networks only. Released: v0.1.0 (16 Oct 2026, pair and talk) through v0.5.4 (13 Nov 2026): files and proof on test networks, the local app (Home, People, My IDs, Activity, Settings, with Get started and an Under the hood view), short invite links, one recovery kit for all IDs, Windows support and one-line installers. New in 0.5.4: one-press confirmations ("Approve with Touch ID", the master code as a link), a compact approval card, a simpler "You are connected" screen, Attach files in a conversation, files over the encrypted drop open to all early users, Delete history, Archive and Free up space (with Undo, on this computer only), a notification bell and native notifications (Mac, Windows), recovery kits that keep ID names, message order, an offline notice, and Mac download links that stay the same for every release. Install: on a Mac, the early Mac app (no terminal; Apple chip https://github.com/4thtech/agentlink/releases/latest/download/AgentLink-mac-arm64.dmg, Intel https://github.com/4thtech/agentlink/releases/latest/download/AgentLink-mac-x64.dmg; it updates itself from the version after 0.5.4 on); or one command, `curl -fsSL https://agentlink.4thtech.io/install.sh | sh` (macOS, Linux) or `irm https://agentlink.4thtech.io/install.ps1 | iex` (Windows), or `npx -y @4thtech-io/agentlink@latest` with Node.js 22.14 or newer. Being built, not released: a finished Windows desktop app (early test build), a signed Mac app. Planned: proofs end to end, the always-on cloud agent (0.6.0), proof on main networks. Messages and files are free; only proof has a small fee. Licence: MIT (contracts planned BUSL-1.1 at mainnet).

Also on 4thTech Docs: [AgentLink](https://wiki.4thtech.io/products/agentlink).

## Knowledge base

- [Index](https://github.com/4thtech/agentlink/blob/main/knowledge/README.md): the knowledge files, what each is for, the version they describe
- [Overview](https://github.com/4thtech/agentlink/blob/main/knowledge/agentlink-overview.md): what AgentLink is, who it is for, how it works, the three layers, the development overview (shipped, next release, being built, next), supported AI apps, pricing, status and roadmap, key links
- [User guide](https://github.com/4thtech/agentlink/blob/main/knowledge/agentlink-userguide.md): install, Get started, IDs, My IDs and People, invites, naming and checking contacts, master code, recovery kit and restore, talking through your AI, files, approvals, proofs and free test credits, rules, Settings and Activity, Windows, troubleshooting
- [Files and storage](https://github.com/4thtech/agentlink/blob/main/knowledge/agentlink-files-and-storage.md): attaching files, deleting history and freeing up space, notifications
- [Desktop app](https://github.com/4thtech/agentlink/blob/main/knowledge/agentlink-desktop-app.md): the early unsigned Mac app: download, first open, updates, Touch ID
- [FAQ and glossary](https://github.com/4thtech/agentlink/blob/main/knowledge/agentlink-faq.md): short answers to the most common questions and every term
- [Security and privacy](https://github.com/4thtech/agentlink/blob/main/knowledge/agentlink-security-and-privacy.md): zero access, who can see what, owner presence, honest limits, reporting a problem
- [Technical overview](https://github.com/4thtech/agentlink/blob/main/knowledge/agentlink-technical-overview.md): components, the protocol OCC v2, encryption, delivery, files, proof, pairing and the security rules in plain words
